panels.title: Temperature, revolutions and fuel pump frequency

targets.legendFormat: Fuel pump frequency (x50, see panel description)

panels.description: Left axis: temperature (°C). Right axis: revolutions (raw units) and fuel pump frequency x50 -- frequency is only ~0-5Hz vs. revolutions' ~0-250, so the plotted value is multiplied by 50 purely to be visible on the shared axis (divide by 50 to get the real Hz value; the dedicated 'Fuel pump frequency' panel below shows it unscaled).

panels.title: Blower speed: defined vs. measured
panels.description: Raw units, not RPM -- see docs/PROTOCOL.md. Measured should track defined closely; a growing gap is worth investigating.

panels.title: Running time
panels.description: Elapsed run time (always available) vs. Running time (extended) -- only populated while debug mode's extended telemetry is active. Should track each other closely once both are present.

panels.title: Engine / relay state (raw codes)
panels.description: Raw diagnostic codes, not individually decoded yet -- useful for spotting when they change, not (yet) for reading a specific meaning off the value.

panels.title: State
panels.description: idle / running / late-run / cooldown / final-shutdown -- from the base 18-byte status frame, always available.

panels.title: Mode of operation (named)
panels.description: Named state/substate from the extended telemetry frame (Low/Middle/High/ignition stages/etc) -- only populated while Extended telemetry active is on.

panels.title: Fault (extended, named)
panels.description: Named fault from the extended frame -- partial table, only 'No faults' cross-validated so far. The numeric Fault code panel above (base frame) is the more reliable one for alerting.

panels.title: Cabin temperature vs. heater output (%)
panels.description: 100% = highest value seen within the currently displayed time range (auto-adjusts as you change the dashboard's time window -- there's no known manufacturer spec to normalize against instead). The two output estimates diverge outside steady combustion -- revolutions track blower/fan activity (nonzero during pre-ignition purge and post-shutdown cooldown), fuel frequency tracks actual heat output (correctly 0 in both cases) -- kept as two series rather than one for exactly that reason. Only extended-frame fields, so only populated while Extended telemetry active is on.
